Sierra Space is a space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and mission systems that safeguard national security and enable space exploration. The Software Engineer I will design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies, write maintainable code, collaborate with senior engineers, manage code through version control, troubleshoot issues, and document software processes.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies
Write clean, maintainable code that adheres to best practices and coding standards
Collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and complete assigned tasks efficiently
Utilizing version control systems such as Git, you will manage code changes and work collaboratively with team members
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and compliance with development standards
Troubleshoot and resolve software-related issues in a timely manner
Document software designs, configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference
Stay current with industry trends and advancements in software development and space technologies to continuously improve your skills and contribute effectively to the team
